mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the current level of FEDFUNDS: lower values predict positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% (historical 10th percentile), or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal policy tightening combined with economic weakness, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise by >0.25pp, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, declining housing starts (HOUST) signal weakening consumer demand and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle periods when HOUST declines >1.0% MoM, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strong labor market conditions supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5% (historical 10th percentile), or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid unemployment rate increase above 4.5% signals economic distress and reduced consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity supporting corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises >0.5% MoM, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In supply shock regimes (declining INDPRO and rising CPIAUCSL), stagflationary pressures reduce corporate margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of supply shock periods (INDPRO decline >0.5% and CPIAUCSL rise >0.3% MoM), or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
